He used a company (hanging under other construction companies) to get the contracts, then after completion gave them kickbacks.

Thus the crime is bribery (giving bribes). The defendant is a private individual giving bribes to public officials? The officials are employees of a private company (real estate developer). Thus final answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
